section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section notes that there are nations of the world who completely deny the existence of G-d.
section.t: For we find that the nations of the world deny the existence of G-d entirely.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section clarifies that this question is not on the maamar itself, but on the Sages' statement that is its foundation.
section.t: Now this question is not on the maamar,
but rather on the statement of our Sages, of blessed memory,
who called Him "the G-d of the gods"
(and it is learned there from a verse — "From the rising of the sun to its setting" etc.),
which statement of our Sages is the foundation explained in the maamar.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the clarification is understood from the Tzemach Tzedek's Sefer HaMitzvos, and is not the place to elaborate.
section.t: And the explanation of this is understood from what is written in the Sefer HaMitzvos of the Tzemach Tzedek, at the end of the mitzvah of the Unity of Hashem; see there.
And elsewhere is not the place.
